slides.title: 5 signs your alarm isn't the problem

slides.heading: you set _6 alarms_
slides.text:
the alarms work fine

_you_ just went to sleep at 2

slides.heading: you sleep through _all of them_
slides.text:
a body on 4 hours of sleep

_doesn't want to hear it_

slides.heading: you turn it off _without waking up_
slides.text:
your thumb knows where the button is

like it knows _where tiktok is_

slides.heading: the first thing you do _is scroll_
you need a reason _to stand up_
slides.text:
my apps stay asleep in the morning _until i walk 200 steps_

hard to scroll when _you're already up_
